description: This PHP script handles exporting keywords from a test management system, supporting CSV and XML formats, initializing page parameters, and managing export actions.

classes.name: tlKeyword
classes.description: Class representing keywords, providing supported serialization interfaces.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes arguments for the export process, validating test project ID and retrieving project name.

methods.name: do_export
methods.description: Performs the export of keywords in CSV or XML format based on user selection, and triggers file download.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI parameters for the export page, including URLs and supported formats.

methods.name: exportKeywordsToCSV
methods.description: Converts a set of keywords into CSV format.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view keywords in the project.
